title: Casper and the Oath
author: Jude Reyes
blurb: Yara Ashgrove, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
